latest_release.name: v4.0.545
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

- [**Remotion now supports proper motion blur**](https://remotion.dev/motion-blur)
- `@remotion/transitions`: Add `motionBlur` to `TransitionSeries.Transition` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13005
- `remotion`: Reject non-finite volume values by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13473
- `remotion`: Align package license declarations by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13433
- `@remotion/cli`: Stop listing `--public-license-key` for `render` and `still` by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13438
- `@remotion/eslint-config-flat`: Bundle patched minimatch and brace-expansion by @andriidrok1 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13309
- `@remotion/media`: Fix seek intent for videos inside `Freeze` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13490
- `@remotion/media`: Point to CORS docs when a network error causes a fallback by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13440
- `@remotion/motion-blur`: Add GPU compositing to `HtmlInCanvasMotionBlur` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13452
- `@remotion/motion-blur`: Add `disabledInPreview` to `<HtmlInCanvasMotionBlur>` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13488
- `@remotion/motion-blur`: Reuse media frames across samples by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13498
- `@remotion/renderer`: Print a one-line error when a usage event can't be sent by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13437
- `@remotion/renderer`: Keep the original error as `cause` when an asset download fails by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13441
- `@remotion/skills`: Fix Claude plugin packaging by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13434
- `@remotion/skills`: Distinguish requirements from capabilities by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13484
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix MPEG-2.5 MP3 and MPEG-2 AAC files being rejected on import by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13411
- `@remotion/studio`: Show a multi-effect context menu when several effects are selected by @VAbhijeetCD in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13418
- `@remotion/studio-server`: Normalize file watcher keys case-insensitively on Windows by @EnesKartal in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13420
- `@remotion/transitions`: Use GPU compositing for transition motion blur by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13487
- `@remotion/transitions`: Warm up transitions during premounting by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13497
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Draw inset and spread box shadows by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13030
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix registered fonts in SVG `foreignObject` exports by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13109
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix CJK text overlapping when words wrap by @jeffierw in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13429
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix audio sample alignment for nonzero frame ranges by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13454
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Keep still and frame renders progressing in background tabs by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13469
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Embed CSS `@font-face` fonts into SVG text by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13470
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Wait for fonts that are still loading by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13480
- `create-video`: Extract templates into a unique temporary directory by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13477

## Templates

- Remove manual premount

detail.readme: - **Make videos agentically**: Turn your idea into a video using your agent. - **Make videos interactively**: Edit and animate like in a regular video editor. - **Make videos programmatically**: Leverage web technology and own your video as code. ## Video Automation - **Design systems**: Create a library of animated assets for your organization. - **Batch rendering**: Render millions of videos on your own infrastructure. - **Applications**: Publish a simple tool or a complex video editor. ## Get started If you already have Node.JS installed, type ```console npx create-video@latest ``` to get started.
